content:
Extract one location and its landmarks. Return one LocationCandidate JSON object only, with fields name, description, parent_name, and landmarks. landmarks is a list of {name, description}.

Rules for local models:
1. A location is an area or place characters can occupy. A landmark is a distinct named feature or focal structure inside that location, not another general area.
2. name and description must be concrete and supported. parent_name is the exact name of a larger containing location only when explicitly implied; otherwise null.
3. Extract landmarks such as a named altar, monument, special tree, shrine feature, gate, or fixed focal structure when the source places it inside this location. Do not extract portable objects as landmarks.
4. Do not duplicate the location itself as a landmark. landmarks may be empty. Do not invent details or names.
